Braincast est un podcast dédié aux neuro: Braincast is a podcast devoted to neuroscience, psychology and how the human brain works. It explains complex scientific research with clear teaching, drawing on experts and recent studies.
Un podcast de vulgarisation scientifique: A popular science podcast about the brain and neuroscience, presented by Ilona Bouvard (Cerveau&Psycho). Performance, learning, emotions, politics, communication… if you want to understand how we relate to the world, all roads lead to the brain. The production is polished and the fortnightly pace leaves time to go deep. Our verdict: promising and necessary. A podcast that deserves a place in every school curriculum. We hope they keep up the pace — and we're adding it to our favourites right now.
